verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a first-party stacked pull request workflow. `cafe stack submit` turns each commit into its own branch and pull request, and works with Git, jj and Sapling. The stack view shows every member with its check state and the first thing blocking the stack. Land merges the stack from the bottom up, with Restack and Unstack also available and live progress shown. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the stacking workflow.
